rationale: The only exception was a unit-of-measure difference: the supplier billed 480 EACH @ $2.00 where the PO was raised as 40 CASE @ $24.00 (pack size 12). Normalised under clause 2 the quantity (40 CASE, matching GR-7702) and unit price match exactly, so it is a clean 3-way match, not a defect. Tax at the vendor's 7.5% recomputes to $72.00, identical to the invoice (clause 5). No credit memos; $1,032.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
